[1] It is the 15th film in the "Godzilla" franchise and the final film in the Shōwa series, and serves as a direct sequel to 1974's "Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla".
[2] Masakatsu Funaki (船木 誠勝 , Funaki Masakatsu , born March 13, 1969 as Masaharu Funaki) is a Japanese actor, mixed martial artist and professional wrestler, who has previously wrestled in All Japan Pro Wrestling (AJPW), New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW), Pro Wrestling Fujiwara Gumi (PWFG), Newborn UWF, and Wrestle-1 (W-1).
[3] Godzilla: Final Wars (ゴジラ ファイナルウォーズ , Gojira: Fainaru Wōzu ) is a 2004 Japanese kaiju film featuring Godzilla, produced and distributed by Toho.
[4] Godzilla: Final Wars - Music from the Motion Picture is the film score to the 2004 film "" composed by Keith Emerson, Nobuhiko Morino, and Daisuke Yano.
